item.description: Mimo 0.1.13 ## 简体中文 ### 新增功能 - 首页新增长驻世界地图，按当前配置标出节点地区和数量。悬停节点分布条可在原位展开其余地区。 - 菜单栏悬停策略组即可查看和切换节点。首页和菜单栏都支持一键测试所有节点，并用颜色区分延迟。 ### 重大修复 - 修复远程控制器显示 DNS 缓存剩余时间时，搜索或切换标签页可能导致的崩溃。 ### 性能优化 - 将抓包正文预览、运行配置搜索和长节点名称的测量移到后台，大型配置导入也可异步保存，减少界面卡顿。 - 缓存日志筛选结果，并合并连续的新日志滚动更新。 ### 体验改进 - 标题栏与地图背景融为一体，侧栏、节点浮层和首页卡片采用 Liquid Glass。 - 重排首页卡片。上传和下载以并排的小卡片显示，订阅更紧凑，网络环境、策略组和内核内存依次排列。 - 节点测速按结果返回顺序更新，同时显示测速进度。关于页增加项目主页入口。 ### 常规修复 - 修复切换策略组时节点列表闪烁，手动选中节点时避免额外触发测速。 - 首页和菜单栏可显示嵌套策略组当前节点的延迟。 ### 内核更新 - 内置 mihomo v1.19.34。 ## English ### New features - The dashboard map marks node regions and counts for the active configuration. Hover over the region strip to show the remaining regions in place. - Hover over a policy group in the menu bar to view and select nodes. The dashboard and menu bar both can test latency for all nodes, with color-coded latency. ### Major fixes - Fixed a Remote Controller crash when searching or switching tabs while the DNS cache expiry countdown was active. ### Performance improvements - Moved captured-body previews, runtime configuration search, and long node-name measurements off the main thread. Large profile imports also save asynchronously. - Cached filtered log entries and batched scroll updates as new log entries arrive. ### Experience improvements - The title bar blends into the map, with Liquid Glass surfaces for the sidebar, node popovers, and dashboard cards. - The dashboard has compact side-by-side upload and download cards, a denser subscription summary, and a stack for network details, policy groups, and core memory. - Latency results appear as tests finish, with a progress indicator. The About page now links to the project homepage. ### Other fixes - Fixed node grid flicker when switching policy groups. Selecting a node manually now preserves existing latency results. - The dashboard and menu bar show latency for the active node in nested policy groups. ### Core update - Bundled mihomo v1.19.34.

## 中文 ### 新增功能 - 配置列表改为卡片展示，集中显示配置类型、流量占比、到期时间和更新时间。 - 自定义配置支持查看远程代理集详情，分别显示各代理集的流量、到期时间和更新时间。 ### 体验改进 - 配置卡片缩小并统一高度，远程代理集明细收进详情弹窗。 - 首页上传、下载卡片缩小并保持等高，保留当前速率和今日累计，峰值移至悬浮提示。 - 移除首页速率卡片中的曲线，界面更紧凑清晰。 ## English ### New Features - Display configurations as cards with their type, traffic usage, expiry date, and last update. - View each remote proxy provider’s usage, expiry date, and last update in custom configuration details. ### Experience Improvements - Use smaller, equal-height configuration cards with remote provider details in a popover. - Compact the upload and download cards to equal heights, showing the current rate and today’s total, with peak rates in tooltips. - Remove the rate charts from the home cards for a cleaner, more compact layout.

Mimo 0.1.11 English New features - Added tiles for streaming and AI endpoint reachability, exit IP information, and IP risk information. - Added local memory, upload, download, and network latency tile templates using the app's existing measurements. - Added Loon installation-link imports and Kelee resource downloads; expanded Surge module routing, managed WebView scripts, and HTTPDNS IP, URL, and User-Agent matching. Major fixes - Fixed a subprocess output-reading race that could unexpectedly terminate the app when a background command finished. - Restore and verify policy selections before enabling enhanced mode to avoid using an unintended node during startup. Performance - Retain visited pages and isolate navigation updates to make sidebar switching smoother. - Prepare Remote Controller tabs ahead of time and reduce page rebuilding on the first switch. Experience improvements - Added compact, customizable tile cards with visible, editable scripts. - Edit remote rewrite modules as local copies while preserving their original sources. Other fixes - Fixed scrolling in the rewrite module source editor. - Restored native sizing for page toolbar actions. - Corrected jq filtering scopes in Coolapk module compatibility. Core update - The bundled mihomo core remains at v1.19.34. 简体中文 新增功能 - 新增流媒体与 AI 入口可达性、出口 IP 信息和 IP 风险信息检测磁贴。 - 新增内存占用、上传流量、下载流量和网络延迟磁贴模板，使用应用已有的实际测量数据。 - 支持导入 Loon 安装链接与下载 Kelee 资源；完善 Surge 模块分流、托管 WebView 脚本，以及 HTTPDNS 的 IP、URL 和 User-Agent 匹配。 重大修复 - 修复后台命令结束时，输出读取竞态可能导致客户端意外退出的问题。 - 开启增强模式前先恢复并校验策略组的节点选择，避免启动期间使用非预期节点。 性能优化 - 保留已访问页面并隔离导航更新，改善侧边栏页面切换流畅度。 - 提前准备远程控制器页签，减少首次切换时的页面重建。 体验改进 - 磁贴卡片支持更紧凑的自定义布局，并可查看和编辑脚本。 - 远程重写模块以本地副本进行编辑，保留原始来源。 常规修复 - 修复重写模块源码编辑器的滚动问题。 - 恢复页面工具栏操作按钮的原生尺寸。 - 修正酷安模块兼容中的 jq 过滤作用域。 内核更新 - 内置 mihomo 版本保持 v1.19.34。
